commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+7' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
90+2' We are about to witness a substitution. Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) is replacing Alvaro Morata.
90+1' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) releases a promising shot from the set piece towards the bottom right corner, but Jean Butez makes a save to deny him.
90+1' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Giovanni Ayroldi signals. Juventus are awarded a free kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
89' What a chance that is! Anastasios Douvikas (Como) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header narrowly wide of the left post.
86' Dani Guindos decides to make a substitution. Ivan Smolcic will be replaced by Stefan Posch (Como).
83' Igor Tudor has decided to make a change. Joao Mario (Juventus) replaces Andrea Cambiaso.
83' Substitution. Daniele Rugani is replaced by Filip Kostic (Juventus).

82' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Jean Butez was alert and the score remains the same.

79' 2 - 0 Goal! Nico Paz (Como) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box inside the left post. Michele Di Gregorio had no chance of reaching it. The score is 2:0.
77' Here is a change. Francisco Conceicao is going off and Igor Tudor gives the last tactical orders to Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus).
77' Substitution. Weston McKennie (Juventus) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Teun Koopmeiners walks off.
75' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) is able to continue to play.
72' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
70' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Juventus comes to nothing.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Maxence Caqueret leaves the pitch and Anastasios Douvikas (Como) comes on.
68' Dani Guindos has decided to substitute Alberto Moreno and he is replaced by Alex Valle (Como).
63' Jean Butez pulls off a fantastic save! Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the left post, but the effort is kept out.
61' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) takes the free kick and curls the ball just over the crossbar. That was close!
61' Giovanni Ayroldi blows the whistle, Lucas Da Cunha (Como) is penalised for a foul. That's a free kick to Juventus.
58' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
55' Maxence Caqueret (Como) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity from the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post.
55' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Michele Di Gregorio has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
54' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 6:9. The current number of shots on goal is 3:0.
51' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
48' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Diego Carlos departs the field of play to be replaced by Jacobo Ramon (Como).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
38' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
36' A goal, which was scored by Jonathan David (Juventus), was disallowed due to offside.
34' Diego Carlos (Como) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
34' Alberto Moreno (Como) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Michele Di Gregorio makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
32' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle and it's Nico Paz (Como) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
31' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) works the corner short.
30' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Como.
27' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
22' Ivan Smolcic (Como) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
21' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
20' The corner from Mergim Vojvoda (Como) is cleared away by the defence.
18' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
17' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
15' That's a well-taken pass by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
12' The referee is firm and issues Alberto Moreno (Como) a deserved yellow card.
10' The game is interrupted. Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
9' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Giovanni Ayroldi who sees an offensive foul.
4' 1 - 0 Goal! Nico Paz puts a cross into the box and finds Marc Oliver Kempf (Como), who latches on to it and strikes the ball inside the left post. He makes it 1:0.
3' Nico Paz (Como) takes a short corner kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Juventus will take the kick-off.
Giovanni Ayroldi will officiate today.
